Class ResourceGeologySectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceGeologySectionBuilder
public class ResourceGeologySectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Geological Tensors, Mineral Endowments invalid input: '&' Deep Earth Energy.

Extracted from ResourceDistributionPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Encapsulates the 10 canonical planetary geological tensors:

  1. Coal: Sedimentary paralic basin thickness, vitrinite reflectance (%Ro), and paleomire accumulation.
  2. Crude Oil: Source rock Total Organic Carbon (%TOC), thermal oil window (60°C–175°C), and anticlinal trap density.
  3. Natural Gas: Deep thermogenic cracking vs. biogenic gas, cratonic reservoir pressures, and caprock evaporite seals.
  4. Uranium: Hydrothermal vein pechblende precipitation, Proterozoic unconformity redox fronts, and \( \text{Th}^{232}/\text{U}^{238} \) ratio.
  5. Helium-3: Lunar/planetary regolith solar-wind implantation, ilmenite (\( \text{FeTiO}_3 \)) capture capacity, and atmospheric shielding factor.
  6. Iron invalid input: '&' Copper: Banded Iron Formations (BIF) and magmatic porphyry intrusions.
  7. Precious Metals: Epithermal vein gold/silver (\( \text{Au, Ag, Pt} \)) and alluvial placer deposits.
  8. Rare Earth Elements (REE) invalid input: '&' Critical Minerals: Carbonatite complexes, pegmatites, and lithium salars.
  9. Mantle Heat Flow: Radiogenic heat, tectonic lithospheric plumes, and geothermal gradients (\( \text{mW/m}^2 \)).
  10. Freshwater Aquifers: Hydrogeological piezometric head, hydraulic conductivity \( K \), and interstitial rock porosity.
